Brentwood Recovery Home - Center Overview

Brentwood Recovery Home – Compassionate Addiction Treatment in Windsor, Ontario

Brentwood Recovery Home is a leading non-profit addiction treatment facility located in Windsor, Ontario, offering comprehensive recovery programs grounded in compassion, community, and spiritual growth. For over 50 years, Brentwood has served individuals and families impacted by alcohol and drug dependency, providing a safe, structured, and supportive environment for those seeking a new way of life.

What sets Brentwood apart is its strong emphasis on peer support, family involvement, and a holistic approach to recovery. As a registered charity, the organization is driven by a mission to help people recover with dignity—regardless of financial situation, background, or belief system.

Client-Centered, Peer-Led Approach

At the heart of Brentwood’s model is its peer-supported recovery philosophy. Many staff members and volunteers are individuals in recovery themselves, providing participants with guidance, empathy, and real-life insights. This connection fosters a powerful sense of hope and accountability throughout the treatment process.

Programs are designed to treat not only the symptoms of addiction but the underlying emotional, psychological, and spiritual issues that contribute to substance use. Brentwood’s person-centered care model ensures that every individual’s recovery path is respected and supported.

Residential Treatment Programs

Brentwood offers live-in addiction recovery programs for men and women, typically lasting 90 to 120 days, depending on individual needs. The structured program includes:

  • Daily group therapy sessions

  • One-on-one counseling

  • Relapse prevention workshops

  • Spiritual guidance and 12-Step meetings

  • Life skills training

  • Fitness and wellness activities

Participants live on-site in a supportive, sober environment where they can focus fully on their healing journey, free from the distractions and triggers of daily life.

Family Recovery Program

Brentwood strongly believes that healing families is key to long-term recovery. Their Family Recovery Program supports loved ones with education, therapy, and workshops to help rebuild trust and communication. By engaging the whole family unit, Brentwood helps break cycles of addiction and supports a healthier, unified future.

Continuing Care and Alumni Support

Recovery doesn’t end at discharge. Brentwood offers comprehensive aftercare services and alumni programming, including:

  • Weekly continuing care meetings

  • Access to on-site support

  • Opportunities for volunteerism

  • Alumni mentorship and community events

These ongoing supports empower former clients to maintain sobriety, connect with others in recovery, and give back to the community.

Affordable, Accessible Help

As a donor-supported non-profit, Brentwood ensures treatment remains affordable and accessible. The organization receives referrals from across Ontario and beyond, welcoming individuals from all walks of life who are ready to begin their recovery.

A Trusted Name in Recovery

With thousands of success stories, Brentwood Recovery Home continues to be a beacon of hope for individuals and families battling addiction. Its commitment to integrity, community, and client-centered care has made it one of Canada’s most respected addiction treatment centres.

Brentwood Recovery Home - Center Overview

Brentwood Recovery Home – Compassionate Addiction Treatment in Windsor, Ontario

Brentwood Recovery Home is a leading non-profit addiction treatment facility located in Windsor, Ontario, offering comprehensive recovery programs grounded in compassion, community, and spiritual growth. For over 50 years, Brentwood has served individuals and families impacted by alcohol and drug dependency, providing a safe, structured, and supportive environment for those seeking a new way of life.

What sets Brentwood apart is its strong emphasis on peer support, family involvement, and a holistic approach to recovery. As a registered charity, the organization is driven by a mission to help people recover with dignity—regardless of financial situation, background, or belief system.

Client-Centered, Peer-Led Approach

At the heart of Brentwood’s model is its peer-supported recovery philosophy. Many staff members and volunteers are individuals in recovery themselves, providing participants with guidance, empathy, and real-life insights. This connection fosters a powerful sense of hope and accountability throughout the treatment process.

Programs are designed to treat not only the symptoms of addiction but the underlying emotional, psychological, and spiritual issues that contribute to substance use. Brentwood’s person-centered care model ensures that every individual’s recovery path is respected and supported.

Residential Treatment Programs

Brentwood offers live-in addiction recovery programs for men and women, typically lasting 90 to 120 days, depending on individual needs. The structured program includes:

  • Daily group therapy sessions

  • One-on-one counseling

  • Relapse prevention workshops

  • Spiritual guidance and 12-Step meetings

  • Life skills training

  • Fitness and wellness activities

Participants live on-site in a supportive, sober environment where they can focus fully on their healing journey, free from the distractions and triggers of daily life.

Family Recovery Program

Brentwood strongly believes that healing families is key to long-term recovery. Their Family Recovery Program supports loved ones with education, therapy, and workshops to help rebuild trust and communication. By engaging the whole family unit, Brentwood helps break cycles of addiction and supports a healthier, unified future.

Continuing Care and Alumni Support

Recovery doesn’t end at discharge. Brentwood offers comprehensive aftercare services and alumni programming, including:

  • Weekly continuing care meetings

  • Access to on-site support

  • Opportunities for volunteerism

  • Alumni mentorship and community events

These ongoing supports empower former clients to maintain sobriety, connect with others in recovery, and give back to the community.

Affordable, Accessible Help

As a donor-supported non-profit, Brentwood ensures treatment remains affordable and accessible. The organization receives referrals from across Ontario and beyond, welcoming individuals from all walks of life who are ready to begin their recovery.

A Trusted Name in Recovery

With thousands of success stories, Brentwood Recovery Home continues to be a beacon of hope for individuals and families battling addiction. Its commitment to integrity, community, and client-centered care has made it one of Canada’s most respected addiction treatment centres.
